etymologies.etymologyHTML: First attested in 1400, from French, from Late Latin accessibilis, from accessus, perfect passive participle of accēdō (“approach”), equivalent to access +‎ -ible.

quote.text: At first sight it would seem that the deep interior of the sun and stars is less accessible to scientific investigation than any other region of the universe.
